name: Joe Cosby-Johnson
summary: Statistician-turned-RevOps operator. Builds the dashboards, margin models, and deal-desk frameworks that help GTM leaders decide what to invest in, what to price up, and what to walk away from — and automates the recurring work with Python and Claude Code.

experience.company_about: AI-first HR and Payroll software for hourly workforces.
experience.role: Sales Strategy & Ops Manager (promoted from GTM Strategy & Ops Analyst)
experience.scope: Operator-level RevOps. Scope spans CRO forecasting, deal desk, comp-plan design, and the agentic-AI automation layer.
highlights: Built and owns executive dashboards in Hex, Tableau, and Snowflake tracking forecast vs. actuals, pipeline health, account-level gross margin, and renewal risk for weekly CEO/CRO/CFO revenue reviews.
Runs weekly revenue forecasting and variance analysis across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success; translates findings into executive-ready narratives and strategic recommendations.

Built an account-level gross-margin model and deal-desk qualification framework guiding pricing, renewal, and go/no-go decisions; designed segmented price-increase programs to protect unit economics at scale.

Owns sales comp-plan design and execution with Finance and Sales leadership; built Python + Claude Code automation for commission calculation, contract classification, and recurring anomaly reporting.

experience.company_about: Experience-management software (CX, EX, Brand, Product). Public company.
experience.role: Revenue Operations Senior Analyst (promoted from Specialist)
experience.scope: Promoted Specialist → Senior Analyst. Owned the weekly global pipeline forecast for the CRO and the strategic dashboards behind go-to-market.
highlights: Built and managed executive Tableau dashboards for Sales, Marketing, and Corporate Strategy — competitive intelligence, win rates, SAM/TAM, and sales performance for a major product line.
Conducted 150+ ad-hoc analyses across pipeline conversion, account prioritization, pricing, nonstandard deal cycles, and rep productivity.
Owned weekly global pipeline forecast delivered directly to the CRO — covering hundreds of reps across industries and regions — concentrating executive attention on the highest-value motions.

experience.company_about: Formerly RStudio. Makers of the RStudio IDE and the Posit data-science platform.
experience.scope: Joined the makers of RStudio out of school to stay close to R and data science; learned enterprise SaaS from the customer-facing seat.
highlights: Managed a portfolio of 250+ customer accounts; negotiated renewals, surfaced churn risk, translated technical R/Python use cases into commercial outcomes.
Built live demos of R workflows (Shiny, API deployment, ETL, environment management) — sharpened the technical-to-commercial translation that carried into later RevOps work.

education.degree: BS Statistics — Applied Stats and Analytics
education.academic_experience: Statistician, Teaching Assistant, and Research Assistant (2019–2020). Sentiment analysis and hypothesis testing on 3,000+ Handshake job postings. Taught Tidyverse, Monte Carlo simulation, and hypothesis testing to 100+ students. ML cluster analysis on Utah DHHS teen-health data.

internships.summary: Automated ETL of 20M+ row tables into Hadoop for Tableau and ML analysis.
Market-segmentation ML to identify buyer personas; conjoint analyses for product-config utility.

automation_and_ai: Claude Code (daily driver for production-grade agentic workflows)

project_archetypes.title: Per-customer gross-margin model
project_archetypes.description: Reframed COGS attribution from top-down budget allocation to bottom-up usage-based event joining. Identified underwater cohorts and cost-driver patterns; reconciled to GL. Used to support deal-desk decisions on renewals, pricing, and walk-aways.

project_archetypes.title: Pipeline scenario modeling under constraints
project_archetypes.description: Built full-year pipeline forecast under business constraints, incorporating multiple sourcing channels with different ramp profiles, seasonality, and risk. Surfaced concentration-risk patterns and defensibility framing for executive review.

project_archetypes.title: Cohort retention and expansion analysis
project_archetypes.description: Calculated per-CSM and team-level NRR/GRR metrics using trailing-window cohort methodology. Identified segment-specific retention patterns to drive book-balancing and target-setting decisions.

project_archetypes.title: Compensation plan design and audit
project_archetypes.description: Designed multi-metric comp structures (quota plus retention-based gates), evaluated trade-offs between simplicity and alignment, and built per-rep simulations under different plan variants. Rebuilt historical commission calc from raw bookings; reconciled against legacy systems and surfaced edge cases.

project_archetypes.title: Pricing floor and discount governance
project_archetypes.description: Established pricing floor hierarchy by package; built governance routing for exceptions; tracked compliance across thousands of contracts.

project_archetypes.title: Quote-check and approval automation
project_archetypes.description: Discovery and taxonomy of an inbound quote-review channel — months of approval requests classified into recurring rule patterns to inform self-service tooling and automation.

project_archetypes.title: Agentic-AI automation layer
project_archetypes.description: Built production-grade Python + Claude Code workflows for commission calculation, contract classification, recurring anomaly reporting, and ad-hoc analyses. Pattern: classifier model → manual review UI → decisions log → next-run feedback. Custom MCP servers integrate with internal data sources.

project_archetypes.title: Multi-touch attribution
project_archetypes.description: Coordinated multi-touch marketing attribution work — defined scope (acquisition vs. nurturing vs. expansion influence), resolved data-quality issues, aligned methodology across Sales, CS, and Marketing.

methodologies: Parallel rollouts for risky CRM formula changes — build the new field side-by-side with the old; cutover is a single flip, no cascade risk.
Build classifier → manual review UI → decisions log → next-run feedback loop for automating judgment-heavy GTM workflows.
Bottom-up cost attribution via event joins — when budget allocation hides reality, reframe with usage events at the customer level.
Trailing-window cohort retention metrics to smooth seasonality in NRR/GRR analysis.
Side-by-side scenario modeling with sensitivity analysis to make risk visible to executives.
Address root causes, not symptoms — workarounds are safety nets, not solutions.
Source-of-truth discipline — single canonical artifact per analysis, with deterministic rebuild from inputs.

Hundreds of reps spanning industries and regions
Multi-channel GTM with marketing, BDR, AE self-source, and customer-success expansion
